# OpsLogic

> OpsLogic is an operations partner helping businesses build and grow in
> India — Employer of Record (EOR), HR Services, Business Setup, and IT
> Services, delivered by one accountable team.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.opslogic.team/): Overview of OpsLogic's operations, HR, business setup and IT solutions.
- [About Us](https://www.opslogic.team/about-us): Vision, mission and values behind OpsLogic.
- [Services](https://www.opslogic.team/services): Overview of all four service lines.
  - [EOR](https://www.opslogic.team/services/eor): Employer of Record — hire and manage employees in India without an entity.
  - [HR Services](https://www.opslogic.team/services/hr): Recruitment, onboarding, HR operations, payroll and employee support.
  - [Business Setup](https://www.opslogic.team/services/business-setup): Establishing and operationalising a business in India.
  - [IT Services](https://www.opslogic.team/services/it): IT infrastructure, support and technology solutions.
- [Careers](https://www.opslogic.team/careers): Open roles and life at OpsLogic.
- [Success Stories](https://www.opslogic.team/success-stories): Client outcomes and case studies.
- [Contact Us](https://www.opslogic.team/contact-us): Get in touch with the OpsLogic team.
